quarterly_data.signal: Meta's 10-Q: as of September 30, 2026 Meta had $454.52 billion of non-cancelable contractual commitments, comprising short-term and long-term arrangements, 'most of which are related to third-party cloud capacity arrangements and other investments in technical infrastructure', and it continues to enter into additional significant contractual arrangements. It also held $10.80 billion of money market funds in escrow under multi-year infrastructure purchase agreements, expected to be released between 2028 and 2030.
